description: Get returns on a miss without unlocking the mutex.
intent: Count cache misses for the hit-rate metric.

findings.label: miss-keeps-lock
findings.explanation: On a miss Get returns while still holding c.mu, so the next Set, Get or Misses call deadlocks.
findings.action: Release the mutex on every return path, for example with defer c.mu.Unlock() after locking.

findings.label: promotional-doc
findings.explanation: The doc comment makes promotional claims instead of stating what Get returns.
findings.action: State that Get returns the value stored under key and whether it was present.
